title: Boston Nineteen Nineteen: The Molasses Wave That Swallowed the City
summary: On January fifteenth, nineteen nineteen, in Boston's North End neighborhood, a giant tank that had never been properly tested burst open, sending eight point seven million liters of molasses surging through the streets in a wave that killed twenty-one people and injured one hundred fifty. The episode traces the story from a manager with no engineering knowledge who hid the leaks with brown paint, to the company's defense that the disaster was an anarchist
